name: Rishabh Sipani
headline: AI Product Manager | IIT (BHU) Varanasi
summary: Product Manager with 6+ years building B2C, e-commerce, and enterprise AI products, from consumer apps and subscription models to AI companions and production LLM agents with evals and guardrails. Experienced in taking products from 0-to-1 and scaling them, turning manual, high-friction workflows into measurable gains in growth, retention, and cost.
